name: Fire walls and fire divisions (A/B/H class)
description: Rated walls and decks divide the platform into fire zones and protect escape routes, the temporary refuge and safety systems. Fire divisions are distinct from blast walls: one resists fire exposure for a rated time, the other resists overpressure.

gaps.what: Fire-division rating, extent and penetration sealing
gaps.why: No page read gives the fire-division rating or the extent of a rated boundary on an offshore module.
gaps.next_action: Fetch the FTP Code or NORSOK S-001 and record the A/B/H ratings, extent and penetration sealing

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
